title: manni structure strict (1.0.0-proposal.1)
description: The strict overlay for manni:structure:1.0.0-proposal.2. Stack it beside the open draft. It narrows the form of values the draft already claims and requires no key. `concepts` is unchanged, because a glossary label may contain spaces.

applies-to.description: Strict holds each label to lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens, in the string form and the list form alike. One prefix such as `deploy:` may lead it.

not-applicable-to.description: Strict holds each label to lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens, in the string form and the list form alike. One prefix such as `deploy:` may lead it.

prerequisites.description: Strict holds each prerequisite to one id, path or URL on one line with no surrounding space, in the string form and the list form alike.

next-steps.description: Strict holds each next step to one id, path or URL on one line with no surrounding space, in the string form and the list form alike.

related-pages.description: Strict holds each related page to one id, path or URL on one line with no surrounding space, in the string form and the list form alike.

applicability.description: A flat applicability label, as a string or as each member of a list. `operator-1.4` and `deploy:k8s-1.30` pass.

refs.description: An id, path or URL on one line with no surrounding space, as a string or as each member of a list.
